question: Which pop superstar just announced she is disappearing?
story: Ariana Grande just told her fans she is stepping out of public life the moment this tour ends. According to Variety and NBC News, Grande said the decision was one she quietly made a long time ago, and that it is not reactive or impulsive. Her Eternal Sunshine tour wraps in London on September first. After that, reports say she is pulling back from public facing work and appearances. Here is the part that made everyone realize she means it. She has also reportedly stepped away from the Stephen Sondheim revival, Sunday in the Park with George, which was set to open at London's Barbican next summer. That was supposed to be her next chapter, and she handed it back. She reportedly told fans she wants to finish the tour healthy and happy, then take a real break from the endless public scrutiny. A handful of shows left. Then quiet.
